description: A four pole filter that morphs between four classic responses, with a low to high morph, an inverse morph and a soft clipping drive

params.text: Morphs the response between the two prototypes the skew knob has chosen, Linkwitz to Butterworth with skew fully counter-clockwise and Legendre to Bessel with it fully clockwise
Chooses which pair of prototypes the spread knob morphs between, Linkwitz and Butterworth at fully counter-clockwise and Legendre and Bessel fully clockwise
Sets the filter frequency, four octaves either side of C4 at 261.63Hz
Morphs the output between a low pass at fully counter-clockwise and a high pass fully clockwise
Sets the level the filter's internal states are clipped at, 2.5V at fully counter-clockwise to 10V fully clockwise
Morphs between the filter's own output at fully counter-clockwise and the input with that output taken back out fully clockwise

inputs.text: Moves the spread on top of the SPD knob, a quarter of a unit per volt
Moves the skew on top of the SKW knob, a quarter of a unit per volt
Moves the filter frequency one octave per volt on top of the FRQ knob
Moves the low to high morph on top of the LAH knob, a quarter of a unit per volt
Moves the clipping level on top of the DRV knob, a quarter of a doubling per volt
Moves the inverse morph on top of the INV knob, a quarter of a unit per volt

notes: the drive clamps the filter's own state variables rather than sitting in the signal path, so lowering it changes the shape of the response as well as the level
